**Summary:**

The modern internet originated in 1969 with ARPANET and evolved through key milestones including the 1983 adoption of TCP/IP protocols and Tim Berners-Lee's 1989 invention of the World Wide Web, which became accessible to mainstream users with the 1993 launch of Mosaic. The late 1990s dot-com boom brought massive investment followed by a 2001 crash, though companies like Amazon and Google emerged as industry giants. The 2000s saw transformative shifts with social media platforms, the 2007 iPhone-driven mobile internet explosion, and AWS founding cloud computing in 2006. Today, the internet connects over 5 billion people and underpins virtually every aspect of modern life.
